title: Famous Places in the World
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris. It is very tall. Many people visit it every year. It is made of iron.

The Great Wall is in China. It is very long. People walk on it. It is a famous place.

questions.text: Why do many people visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: It is an interesting place to see

questions.text: What kind of place is the Great Wall?
options: A very long and famous wall

vocabulary.definition: high, from the bottom to the top
to go to a place to see it
a hard metal used to make things

paragraph_translations: Eyfel Kulesi Paris'tedir. Çok yüksektir. Her yıl birçok insan onu ziyaret eder. Demirden yapılmıştır.
Çin Seddi Çin'dedir. Çok uzundur. İnsanlar onun üzerinde yürür. Ünlü bir yerdir.
